Root-leaf Text General families0/1 and Binary controls run both ACE16 headers5/6; node/contraction controls cover actual bounded/tail child forms.

Existing page::read_profile grammar unchanged. Preserving wrapper delegates semantic decode, requires complete consumption and owns exact reconstructed key slice; checked page parser independently extracts row/child trailers. Semantic comparison is never replaced by arbitrary encoded Binary byte ordering.

Delete-only RetainedProfile owns metered fallible key copies; original WriteProfile remains Copy/update/includes contract. Existing numeric deletion delegates unchanged. Shared repacker borrows a narrow encoder; UPDATE keeps its old semantic serializer and gates.

Preserved wire serialization generates neither new Text weights nor semantic Binary encoding. Complete before/post checks still encode row values and retain existing unique/digest/collation restrictions, so no encoder-free operation is claimed.

Nonunique Short Text overflow/digest can qualify through complete check. Unique overflow, Memo/Long Text, variable/Text/Binary composites, unsupported sort metadata and ignored-NULL mutation remain refused, including no-op requests.
Only explicit delete admission bypasses default early ShortBinary blocker. Indexed Binary UPDATE/no-op stays refused; no normal ACE writer/backend/CLI capability or macro eligibility expands.

Existing root/leaf/ancestor maxima and retirement safeguards remain; current internal-node sibling-link retirement limitation is retained and separately investigated. No new page/map allocation or nonempty root promotion.

Original public-writer Text/Binary candidate replay is separate and unrun here. No native Microsoft Access SQL/save/reopen qualification, journalable plan, INSERT, active-content execution or constraint waiver.
